fading.title: Fading & let go
fading.explain: Things you haven’t used fade after 30 days and are let go after 90. Nothing here is deleted. Bring anything back with one tap.
fading.section.fading: Fading · will be let go soon
fading.letGo.days: let go in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
fading.letGo.weeks: let go in {count, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}
fading.empty.all: Nothing is fading or let go. Things you haven’t used for a while show up here first.
fading.error: I couldn’t open this list. What you kept is safe.
fading.announce.kept: Kept. It will not fade for 30 days.
fading.announce.broughtBack: {count, plural, one {Brought back. It will not fade for 30 days.} other {Brought back # things. They will not fade for 30 days.}}
fading.announce.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing was changed.
